The change is a trivial performance refactor: `getCurrentUser()` and `context.params` are now awaited in parallel via `Promise.all` instead of sequentially. Both were `await`ed before and are `await`ed now; the auth gate at line 45 still runs before `fetchExternalEvent(slug)` (line 49), the ownership check (lines 57–62), and the mutation `deleteEventById` (line 64). No new sink, no new source, no gate weakening, no error-path fail-open, no logging of sensitive data. Order-of-execution parallelization of two side-effect-free reads has no security impact.

Nothing to report.
